Verses.VerseAr: يٰۤاَيُّهَا الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا لَا تُقَدِّمُوۡا بَيۡنَ يَدَىِ اللّٰهِ وَرَسُوۡلِهٖ‌ وَاتَّقُوۡا اللّٰهَ‌ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ سَمِيۡعٌ عَلِيۡمٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: O Believers! Do not step ahead of Allah and His Messenger ([blessings and peace be upon him] in any matter) and keep fearing Allah (lest some discourtesy should occur displeasing the Messenger [blessings and peace be upon him]). Surely Allah is All-Hearing, All-Knowing.

Verses.VerseAr: يٰۤاَيُّهَا الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا لَا تَرۡفَعُوۡۤا اَصۡوَاتَكُمۡ فَوۡقَ صَوۡتِ النَّبِىِّ وَلَا تَجۡهَرُوۡا لَهٗ بِالۡقَوۡلِ كَجَهۡرِ بَعۡضِكُمۡ لِبَعۡضٍ اَنۡ تَحۡبَطَ اَعۡمَالُكُمۡ وَاَنۡـتُمۡ لَا تَشۡعُرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: O Believers! Do not raise your voices above the voice of the Prophet (blessings and peace be upon him) and (also) do not speak to him so loud as you are loud when you speak to one another (lest) all your actions should come to nothing (including your faith), and you are not even aware (that your faith and all pious works have been wrecked).

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ يَغُضُّوۡنَ اَصۡوَاتَهُمۡ عِنۡدَ رَسُوۡلِ اللّٰهِ اُولٰٓٮِٕكَ الَّذِيۡنَ امۡتَحَنَ اللّٰهُ قُلُوۡبَهُمۡ لِلتَّقۡوٰى‌ؕ لَهُمۡ مَّغۡفِرَةٌ وَّاَجۡرٌ عَظِيۡمٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Assuredly those who keep their voices low in the Presence of Allah’s Messenger (out of profound veneration and submissiveness), it is they whose hearts Allah has chosen for Godwariness and permeated with sincerity. For them alone is forgiveness and an immense reward.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ يُنَادُوۡنَكَ مِنۡ وَّرَآءِ الۡحُجُرٰتِ اَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لَا يَعۡقِلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Verily those who call out to you from outside your apartments, most of them do not have the understanding (of your exalted station and incomparable status and polite manners of paying you most humble regards).

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَوۡ اَنَّهُمۡ صَبَرُوۡا حَتّٰى تَخۡرُجَ اِلَيۡهِمۡ لَـكَانَ خَيۡرًا لَّهُمۡ‌ؕ وَاللّٰهُ غَفُوۡرٌ رَّحِيۡمٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And if they had only been patient till you had come out to them, it would have been better for them. And Allah is Most Kind, Ever-Merciful.

Verses.VerseAr: يٰۤاَيُّهَا الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡۤا اِنۡ جَآءَكُمۡ فَاسِقٌ ۢ بِنَبَاٍ فَتَبَيَّنُوۡۤا اَنۡ تُصِيۡبُوۡا قَوۡمًا ۢ بِجَهَالَةٍ فَتُصۡبِحُوۡا عَلٰى مَا فَعَلۡتُمۡ نٰدِمِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: O Believers! If some wicked person brings you any news, inquire thoroughly into its truth (lest) you should cause (undue) harm to a people unknowingly, and later feel regret for what you have done.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاعۡلَمُوۡۤا اَنَّ فِيۡكُمۡ رَسُوۡلَ اللّٰهِ‌ؕ لَوۡ يُطِيۡعُكُمۡ فِىۡ كَثِيۡرٍ مِّنَ الۡاَمۡرِ لَعَنِتُّمۡ وَلٰـكِنَّ اللّٰهَ حَبَّبَ اِلَيۡكُمُ الۡاِيۡمَانَ وَزَيَّنَهٗ فِىۡ قُلُوۡبِكُمۡ وَكَرَّهَ اِلَيۡكُمُ الۡكُفۡرَ وَالۡفُسُوۡقَ وَالۡعِصۡيَانَ‌ؕ اُولٰٓٮِٕكَ هُمُ الرّٰشِدُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And remember that the Messenger of Allah (blessings and peace be upon him) is among you. If he accepted what you say in most of the matters, you would be in serious trouble. But Allah has blessed you with the love of faith and has embelished it in your hearts and has made you hate disbelief, disobedience and sins. Such are they that follow the path of Din (Religion) resolutely and steadfastly.

Words.MeaningEn: surely you would be in difficulty

Verses.VerseAr: فَضۡلاً مِّنَ اللّٰهِ وَنِعۡمَةً   ؕ وَاللّٰهُ عَلِيۡمٌ حَكِيۡمٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (It) is due to Allah’s Bounty and Favour (i.e. the raising of the untaught Messenger and his Presence among you). And Allah is All-Knowing, Most Wise.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِنۡ طَآٮِٕفَتٰنِ مِنَ الۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ اقۡتَتَلُوۡا فَاَصۡلِحُوۡا بَيۡنَهُمَا‌ۚ فَاِنۡۢ بَغَتۡ اِحۡدٰٮهُمَا عَلَى الۡاُخۡرٰى فَقَاتِلُوۡا الَّتِىۡ تَبۡغِىۡ حَتّٰى تَفِىۡٓءَ اِلٰٓى اَمۡرِ اللّٰهِ ‌ۚ فَاِنۡ فَآءَتۡ فَاَصۡلِحُوۡا بَيۡنَهُمَا بِالۡعَدۡلِ وَاَقۡسِطُوۡا ؕ‌ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يُحِبُّ الۡمُقۡسِطِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And if two parties of the Muslims fight, make them reconcile. Then if either of these (parties) commits injustice and aggression against the other, fight against that (party) who are committing aggression till they turn to Allah’s command. When they revert and submit, make peace between them with equity. And put justice to work. Surely Allah loves those who do justice.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّمَا الۡمُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ اِخۡوَةٌ فَاَصۡلِحُوۡا بَيۡنَ اَخَوَيۡكُمۡ‌ وَاتَّقُوۡا اللّٰهَ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُرۡحَمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: The truth is that (all) believers are brothers (to one another). So make peace between your two brothers and always fear Allah, so that you may be shown Mercy.

Verses.VerseAr: يٰۤاَيُّهَا الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا لَا يَسۡخَرۡ قَوۡمٌ مِّنۡ قَوۡمٍ عَسٰٓى اَنۡ يَّكُوۡنُوۡا خَيۡرًا مِّنۡهُمۡ وَلَا نِسَآءٌ مِّنۡ نِّسَآءٍ عَسٰٓى اَنۡ يَّكُنَّ خَيۡرًا مِّنۡهُنَّ‌ۚ وَلَا تَلۡمِزُوۡۤا اَنۡفُسَكُمۡ وَلَا تَنَابَزُوۡا بِالۡاَلۡقَابِ‌ؕ بِئۡسَ الِاسۡمُ الۡفُسُوۡقُ بَعۡدَ الۡاِيۡمَانِ‌ ۚ وَمَنۡ لَّمۡ يَتُبۡ فَاُولٰٓٮِٕكَ هُمُ الظّٰلِمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: O Believers! Let no community ridicule another community. It is likely that they may be better than those (who ridicule). Nor should women make fun of other women. It is likely that they may be better than those (who make fun). And do not offend or find fault with one another, nor call each other names. Calling someone wicked or indecent after (he embraces) faith is an extremely evil name. And those who do not turn to Allah in repentance it is they who are the wrongdoers.

Verses.VerseAr: يٰۤاَيُّهَا الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا اجۡتَنِبُوۡا كَثِيۡرًا مِّنَ الظَّنِّ اِنَّ بَعۡضَ الظَّنِّ اِثۡمٌ‌ وَّلَا تَجَسَّسُوۡا وَلَا يَغۡتَبْ بَّعۡضُكُمۡ بَعۡضًا‌ؕ اَ يُحِبُّ اَحَدُكُمۡ اَنۡ يَّاۡكُلَ لَحۡمَ اَخِيۡهِ مَيۡتًا فَكَرِهۡتُمُوۡهُ‌ؕ وَاتَّقُوۡا اللّٰهَ‌ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ تَوَّابٌ رَّحِيۡمٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: O Believers! Avoid most conjectures. Indeed some conjectures are sins (liable to punishment in the Hereafter). And spy not (on someone’s unknown matters or secrets), nor backbite one another. Would any of you like to eat the flesh of his dead brother? You would hate it. And fear Allah (in all such matters). Indeed Allah is Ever-Returning, Ever-Merciful.

Verses.VerseAr: يٰۤاَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اِنَّا خَلَقۡنٰكُمۡ مِّنۡ ذَكَرٍ وَّاُنۡثٰى وَجَعَلۡنٰكُمۡ شُعُوۡبًا وَّقَبَآٮِٕلَ لِتَعَارَفُوۡا‌ؕ اِنَّ اَكۡرَمَكُمۡ عِنۡدَ اللّٰهِ اَتۡقٰٮكُمۡ‌ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ عَلِيۡمٌ خَبِيۡرٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: O people! We created you from a male and a female, and (divided) you into (large) peoples and tribes, so that you might recognize one another. Surely the most honourable among you in the sight of Allah is he who fears Allah most. Certainly Allah is All-Knowing, All-Aware.

Words.MeaningEn: that you may know one another

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَتِ الۡاَعۡرَابُ اٰمَنَّا‌ ؕ قُل لَّمۡ تُؤۡمِنُوۡا وَلٰـكِنۡ قُوۡلُوۡۤا اَسۡلَمۡنَا وَلَمَّا يَدۡخُلِ الۡاِيۡمَانُ فِىۡ قُلُوۡبِكُمۡ‌ۚ وَاِنۡ تُطِيۡعُوۡا اللّٰهَ وَرَسُوۡلَهٗ لَا يَلِتۡكُمۡ مِّنۡ اَعۡمَالِكُمۡ شَيْئًا ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ غَفُوۡرٌ رَّحِيۡمٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: The Bedouins say: ‘We have believed.’ Say: ‘You have not believed. Yes, rather say: We have accepted Islam. And the belief has not yet gone into your hearts. If you obey Allah and His Messenger (blessings and peace be upon him), He will not decrease anything (in reward) for your deeds. Surely Allah is Most Forgiving, Ever-Merciful.’

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّمَا الۡمُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا بِاللّٰهِ وَرَسُوۡلِهٖ ثُمَّ لَمۡ يَرۡتَابُوۡا وَجٰهَدُوۡا بِاَمۡوَالِهِمۡ وَاَنۡفُسِهِمۡ فِىۡ سَبِيۡلِ اللّٰهِ‌ؕ اُولٰٓٮِٕكَ هُمُ الصّٰدِقُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: The true believers are only those who have believed in Allah and His Messenger (blessings and peace be upon him) and then never get into doubt, and who fight in the way of Allah with their material as well as human resources. It is they who are true (in their claim to believe).

Verses.VerseAr: قُلۡ اَتُعَلِّمُوۡنَ اللّٰهَ بِدِيۡنِكُمۡؕ وَاللّٰهُ يَعۡلَمُ مَا فِىۡ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَمَا فِىۡ الۡاَرۡضِ‌ؕ وَاللّٰهُ بِكُلِّ شَىۡءٍ عَلِيۡمٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Say: ‘Are you trying to show off to Allah your Din (Religion) while Allah knows all that is in the heavens and in the earth? And Allah is Well Aware of everything.’

Verses.VerseAr: يَمُنُّوۡنَ عَلَيۡكَ اَنۡ اَسۡلَمُوۡا‌ؕ قُل لَّا تَمُنُّوۡا عَلَىَّ اِسۡلَامَكُمۡ‌ۚ بَلِ اللّٰهُ يَمُنُّ عَلَيۡكُمۡ اَنۡ هَدٰٮكُمۡ لِلۡاِيۡمَانِ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ صٰدِقِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: These people are showing off to you that they have done a favour to you by embracing Islam. Say: ‘Do not show off your Islam as a favour to me. Instead, Allah is the One Who favours you by guiding you to faith provided you are true (to belief).’

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يَعۡلَمُ غَيۡبَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ‌ؕ وَاللّٰهُ بَصِيۡرٌۢ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely Allah knows all the unseen of the heavens and the earth, and Allah monitors best whatever you do.
